Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. {style_lock}. Photographed at a gentle high 30-degree angle over an open timber shelf board reading approximately #7A4A26, the deep brown #4A2A16 bay interior above it held as a clean dark copy band, the closed bottle resting lower-centre on the board as one clean composition of clear cap, domed collar ring in its exact reference tone, twin swept-down handle wings, transparent body with soft shoulder taper and rounded base, the nipple seated inside with nothing detached and one true warm contact shadow plus one long soft shadow running to camera right holding it down so it does not float. One low golden dusk key at about 3500K enters from camera left at just above board height and skims the grain: the clear body carries one narrow vertical specular along its camera-left flank and one soft warm caustic on the board, the cap crown and the near handle wing one small warm highlight each, medium contrast, gentle falloff into the unlit interior, no overhead source, no front-top wash, no hard-edged cut shadow and no cool fill. Wide structured whitespace in the bay interior holds one closing headline reading 「{selling_point_7}」 reversed out in ecru #E2D8C3 with one short hand-drawn-style ochre #C6871E stroke underlined beneath it and one short sub-line reading 「{callout_1}」 a size step smaller, then one blank rectangular action card drawn on a deckled-edge ecru #E2D8C3 card lying at the camera-right end of the board and carrying only the short rendered label 「{callout_2}」 of no more than eight characters, and two blank label lines each on a hairline leader ending in one small hand-drawn arc bracket reserved for 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」. Along the board front one short ochre index stroke carries two small arc brackets cradling light sans ordinals; no seal artwork, no arrow badge and no other readable words anywhere. One unmarked matte stoneware jar corner rests behind the card as an honest scale anchor, clear of the product, and the printed label area on the bottle stays one blank legible field. The product occupies 45-50% of the frame.
